inputs.text: [excited] It was 3.4 meters long — [quickly] like a small car! Standing up, it was 0.9 meters tall — as tall as a 4-year-old! And it weighed 80 kilos — [proud] as heavy as Dad. [amazed] And scientists think it could run about 19 miles an hour — as fast as a horse cantering.
[curious] And its famous claw, [gasps] how big was it?
[confident] About 5 inches. [serious] Curved, razor-sharp — a real weapon for hooking prey.
